_help.selfTangleBy: Sprout (the tutorial game's AI) starts preferring moves that walk ONE of its glyphlings into a pocket — next to your pieces when it can, so you see the tangle bonus — from this turn of its own. Lower = it happens sooner. A preference, never a rule: if the board offers no pocket, it doesn't happen. Try 4–8.
_help.maxTurns: After this many of its own turns Sprout drops both its preferences (one self-tangle, then keeping its other glyphling free) and plays like any Apprentice. Try 15–25.

_labels.selfTangleBy: Sprout: tries to tangle one of its glyphlings from its turn…
_labels.maxTurns: Sprout: drops its tutorial habits after this many of its turns
